slides.title: The cheapest part in your rental protects the most expensive one.
slides.sub: The air filter, in three steps.

slides.label: Step
slides.title: Read the size off the edge.
slides.body: It's printed on the cardboard frame of the filter you pull out. Buy the same size and the same rating.

slides.label: Step
slides.title: Point the arrow at the unit.
slides.body: The arrow on the frame shows which way the air moves. It points away from the vent and toward the system.

slides.label: Step
slides.title: Change it on a schedule.
slides.body: Every 60 days from May through September, when the AC runs hardest here. Every 90 days the rest of the year.

slides.title: A clogged filter can freeze the coil. The repair is the owner's.
slides.sub: Put filter changes in the lease with dates. We log filter condition at every annual inspection.

slides.title: Send this to someone who has never changed theirs.
slides.action: Follow for one fix a week.
lines: General information, not legal advice. Your lease says who changes the filter.
